title: Reported Domestic Violence Cases against Women
what_it_is: Reported Domestic Violence Cases against Women

sections.label: Women PPO applications
sections.summary: About 75% of applications were by women, and about 20% of these women, or about 450 applications, were above 50.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Around 75% of the applications were made by women.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Of these women, about 20%, or about 450 applications, were from those above 50 years of age.

sections.label: PPO applications and family violence survey
sections.summary: PPO applications by women above 50 stayed relatively stable, with 480 in 2014 and 430 in 2016, and an MSF survey found fears about reporting family violence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Based on the available statistics, the number of PPO applications by women above the age of 50 has remained relatively stable over the last three years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: MSF did a survey in January last year to uncover a little bit more about the problem of family violence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: About 40% feared reporting family violence because they felt it was a private matter.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: About half feared that reporting the matter will break up the family.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Slightly more than a third was unsure exactly what family violence was and how to get help.
